regime_context: Eligibility is broadening (22 of 49 themes above the absolute-trend gate) but rotation breadth itself is narrowing (0.45) and the leader margin is slim (0.185). AI Infrastructure leads with a mediocre durability bar (0.5) and weak breadth (0.125); energy themes are the closest challengers with better breadth. Gate helps on this history, so trend discipline is sanctioned, but rank-IC is ~0 and my own directional track record is near coin-flip (0.46), so conviction must stay low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the energy-complex vs. AI-Infrastructure margin (0.185) widens in energy's favor with AI breadth staying under 0.2 — only a confirmed leader swap in the rotation block (energy score exceeding AI score on consecutive detector readings) would retire this watch.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy has the strongest breadth (0.636) among eligible upper-rank themes and an above-median durability bar (0.62), with crowding still moderate (z=0.93). The rotation structure shows energy as the only credible challenger to AI Infrastructure with a narrow 0.185 margin, while AI's own breadth (0.125) is collapsing — a handoff is plausibly forming, not confirmed. Lean long on the existing trend, not on a predicted handoff.
theses.dissent: Energy breadth is itself a lagging expression of already-realized mean-reversion from oil repositioning; with unscheduled macro surprise share at 0.75, commodity/energy is the most headline-sensitive bucket and the trend can invert before the 30d horizon.

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 4% over any 10-trading-day stretch with XLE closing below its 50-day moving average

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The leader is eligible and has the top score (1.56) but its internal structure is deteriorating: breadth is only 0.125, durability_bar is a tepid 0.5, and 'one_narrative' is false. The crowding flag is absent, so I will not fade it — but I will not add on a theme whose participation is so thin and whose leadership margin over energy has compressed to 0.185.
theses.dissent: AI Infrastructure is still the only theme with positive absolute trend plus top rank; its thin breadth may simply reflect mega-cap concentration (SMH proxy) rather than real deterioration, and avoiding a still-trending leader forfeits the only validated edge.

falsifier.text: SMH closes above its 20-day high with breadth expanding above 0.4 before the 21-trading-day horizon

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity has the strongest durability_bar of the eligible top ranks (0.75) and a clean 'trend' Hurst tag, but it is the ONLY crowded theme among the top five (z=1.61, crowded=true). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade — so I express caution as an avoid on new exposure rather than an underweight.
evidence: guardrails.do_not_conclude: crowding is a size-down caution, not a sell/short/fade
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity's crowding_z may be a coincident artefact of defensive bid in a high-surprise (0.75 unscheduled share) macro backdrop; the strong durability bar and trend tag argue the trend could persist despite the crowd.

falsifier.text: CIBR's crowding_z falls below 1.0 while it maintains rank 3 or better over the horizon

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
